fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company expects to consume approximately 1.4 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2006.

instrument_type_details.notes: Mixture of purchased call options, collar structures, and fixed price swap agreements. Hedging via crude oil, heating oil, and unleaded gasoline contracts.

warnings: Prices reported in crude oil equivalent per barrel, not per gallon. Volume percentages apply to total anticipated jet fuel requirements.
pct_hedged for 2006 reported as 'over 70 percent' — recorded as 70 (floor). For 2007 'over 60 percent' — recorded as 60. For 2008 'over 35 percent' — recorded as 35.

Net fair value reported as approximately $1.7 billion in item7a; Note 10 fair value table shows Fuel Contracts carrying/fair value of $1,678 million. Used $1,700 as rounded figure consistent with text.
Note 10 mentions $1.1 billion long-term portion but item7a states $1.0 billion — minor discrepancy in rounding.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel and oil expense table: average cost $1,341 million, average cost per gallon $1.03 (Item 1, 2007 10-K filing)
